run_eval_hpatches: run the eval script to process HPatches image pairs and extract keypoints
transform_hpatches_elem: transform an HPatches element by extracting original and warped images and saving keypoints
cache_hpatches_dataset: cache the HPatches dataset with a transform function and write output to an h5 file
run_main_hpatches: run the main entry point to execute the HPatches evaluation pipeline
define_hpatches_transform: define a transform function that adds original_points, warped_points, and matched keypoints to each element
